_comment: Copy this to `config.json` and edit it. Every key is optional: anything you
leave out keeps its built-in default, so you can start with just `line` and
python iett_tracker.py --search kadikoy    (search stops by name)
Keys beginning with _ are ignored, so comments like this are safe.
_line: The line you track. Used as the default for --map and friends.
_focus: The boarding points you actually use. Each becomes a button on the hero card,
showing the next buses to that stop. One entry is fine; two gives you the
there-and-back toggle. `label` is the button text, `at` is the small caption.
These stops are also the ones prediction accuracy is scored against.
_eta: Which stop the live ETA panel watches, and on which lines.
_home_stops: Stops drawn with the 'boarding' marker on the map.
_return_stops: Stops drawn with the return marker.
_dest_hints: Lowercase fragments; any stop whose name contains one gets flagged on the
map. Handy for a landmark you navigate by. Leave [] if you don't care.
_line_colors: Bus arrow colour per line. Anything not listed uses a default.
_directions: Direction filter, so buses going the wrong way are hidden. 'g' or 'd' match
the route leg; any other text is matched against the destination name. Omit a
line entirely to show BOTH directions, which is what you want for a short
ring route where every bus is useful.
_app_name: Shown in the browser tab and when added to a phone home screen.
_eta_speed_kmh: Fallback speed for the rough estimate when nothing is learned yet.
